hyperedges.label: Quick-Logging Dock (Timer, Diapers, Sleep, Last Nursed)
Single Action Dialog Serving Multiple Bottom Sheets

nodes.label: Self-Hosted OFL Fonts (Fredoka + Nunito Sans)
nodes.rationale: Fonts are subsetted OFL WOFF2 served from the binary so there is no third-party font request or layout shift.

nodes.label: SIL Open Font License 1.1
nodes.rationale: Fonts may be bundled and redistributed with software provided reserved names are not reused and derivatives stay under the OFL; this permits self-hosting the fonts in one binary.

nodes.label: Nurtur Brand Mascot: Smiling Cream Fruit with Leaves
nodes.norm_label: nurtur brand mascot: smiling cream fruit with leaves

nodes.label: Nurtur Friendly Fruit Mascot App Icon
nodes.norm_label: nurtur friendly fruit mascot app icon

nodes.label: Manual Release Gate (soak, sync outage, restore, 3 a.m. test)
nodes.norm_label: manual release gate (soak, sync outage, restore, 3 a.m. test)

nodes.label: Playwright Browser Smoke Suite (390x844)
nodes.rationale: Covers the path that cannot be unit-tested: reload mid-feed, OOB swaps, delete/undo in place, and the export endpoints, at a real phone viewport against its own local-only server.

nodes.label: Chronological Feed with Quick Undo
nodes.rationale: Accidental taps happen constantly while nursing, so a one-click HTMX delete keeps data clean without tedious confirmation dialogs.

nodes.label: Last Nursed Indicator
nodes.rationale: Eliminates the perpetual 'which side did I feed on last?' guesswork with a high-contrast header badge.

nodes.label: Night Mode & Single-Hand UX
nodes.rationale: Nursing sessions at 3:00 AM require dark slate/black backgrounds with muted amber text to avoid waking the baby; primary buttons belong in the bottom third for thumb reach.

nodes.label: Resilient Timer State (localStorage + backend sync)
nodes.rationale: Timer must survive browser refresh, tab switches and screen locks without resetting or losing counted seconds.

nodes.label: Sleep & Nap Tracker with Wake Window Counter
nodes.norm_label: sleep & nap tracker with wake window counter

nodes.label: Recommended Minimal SQLite Schema
nodes.rationale: Deliberately minimal starting schema (feeds, diapers, sleeps); PLANS.md later corrects it with feed segments, diaper consistency and soft deletes.

nodes.label: Injected Clock Interface (elapsed time in Go)
nodes.norm_label: injected clock interface (elapsed time in go)
nodes.rationale: Elapsed time is computed in Go from a single injected Clock, not in SQL, so tests can freeze time and DST/midnight boundaries can be tested.

nodes.label: Feed Segments Model (derived per-side durations)
nodes.rationale: A single feeds row cannot represent left 8 min → right 12 min → left 3 min without losing when each side happened; totals are derived from segments so stored values never drift after edits.

nodes.label: Feeding State Machine (IDLE / ACTIVE(side))
nodes.rationale: Tapping the already-active side must be a no-op with a toast, and Done must never sit adjacent to a switch target, so a mis-tap cannot end the session.

nodes.label: HTMX Out-of-Band Update Convention
nodes.rationale: Never replace #app or the scroll container on a mutation; targeted outerHTML plus OOB companions is what prevents the page-jump problem.

nodes.label: Night-First Day/Night Token Palette
nodes.rationale: Night is the default experience after 21:00 and day is the override, because the 3 a.m. session is the critical use case; the inline head script prevents a white flash.

nodes.label: Non-Goals for v1 (single user, single baby, no notifications)
nodes.norm_label: non-goals for v1 (single user, single baby, no notifications)
nodes.rationale: Breadth is deliberately refused (no multi-user, multi-baby, charts, notifications, analytics) because the product wins on speed and reliability for one mother.

nodes.label: Partial Unique Indexes for Active Sessions
nodes.norm_label: partial unique indexes for active sessions
nodes.rationale: one_active_feed, one_open_feed_segment and one_open_sleep back up the application checks so concurrent double-taps cannot create two active sessions.

nodes.label: Phase 1 — Foundation + Nursing Core
nodes.rationale: Ship Phase 1 to a real phone before starting Phase 2; timer reliability and thumb reach cannot be validated on a desktop browser.

nodes.label: Pip the Sprout Mascot
nodes.rationale: Pip (awake/nursing/sleeping/empty poses) is decoration with personality, never a status mechanism, and never sits on top of a control — text must always be sufficient.

nodes.label: Progressive Enhancement Contract
nodes.rationale: Every mutation is a real form; HTMX only intercepts it, and without HTMX the server returns 303 See Other, so the app works with JS disabled.

nodes.label: Soft Delete (deleted_at) for Real Undo
nodes.rationale: Soft delete enables real undo without confirmation dialogs, and deleted active sessions are closed first then soft-deleted in one transaction.

nodes.label: Local-First Turso Topology (local file + async Push/Pull)
nodes.norm_label: local-first turso topology (local file + async push/pull)
nodes.rationale: Local Turso file is the authoritative write path for sub-millisecond logging at 3 a.m.; debounced Push and periodic Pull give a durable off-site copy, so a cloud outage never blocks a feed or diaper log.

nodes.label: Debian-slim (glibc) Docker Runtime for tursogo
nodes.rationale: tursogo loads a prebuilt native library through purego, so the image must be glibc-based (Debian slim, not Alpine); the service runs non-root with the DB on /data.

nodes.label: JSON/CSV/SQL Export and Restore Drill
nodes.rationale: The SQL export includes schema_migrations and soft-deleted rows so it replays into a fresh Turso/SQLite database without re-running migrations and restores faithfully.

nodes.label: Local Account Onboarding with Signup Key
nodes.norm_label: local account onboarding with signup key
nodes.rationale: One local PBKDF2-SHA256 account guarded by a signup key, with no email/OAuth dependency; auth stays optional and off by default for a solo user on a trusted LAN.

nodes.label: Local-First Write Path with Debounced Push/Pull
nodes.norm_label: local-first write path with debounced push/pull

nodes.label: PWA Shell, Service Worker and Offline Page
nodes.norm_label: pwa shell, service worker and offline page
nodes.rationale: sw.js is served from the domain root so it controls the whole app; navigation is network-first and never cached because a cached authenticated page could outlive the sign-in gate.

nodes.label: One Server Instance per Database Constraint
nodes.norm_label: one server instance per database constraint
nodes.rationale: The sync engine and one-active-feed constraints assume a single writer; this is a solo-user app, not a multi-tenant service.

nodes.label: History and In-Place Undo
nodes.rationale: A deleted row is replaced by a hidden placeholder so Undo can restore it into the exact same spot; restoration re-validates overlap and active-session rules.

nodes.label: How the Timer Stays Honest
nodes.rationale: Server stores UTC RFC3339 and is the only source of truth; the client mirrors state in localStorage but always reconciles to the server so lock/refresh/server-restart loses nothing.

nodes.label: Zero-Friction One-Handed Use (Golden Rule)
nodes.rationale: The user is frequently half-asleep, holding a nursing or crying baby in one arm, and operating her phone with a single thumb, so every interaction must be near-zero friction.

nodes.label: Design Principles (Thumb First, Cute but Quiet)
nodes.norm_label: design principles (thumb first, cute but quiet)
nodes.rationale: The top 55% of the screen is for reading and the bottom 45% for acting; one primary decision per state; playful details must never compete with a control.

nodes.label: Action Dialog Sheet System
nodes.rationale: A single persistent #action-dialog is filled by the .Sheet value (nursing/diaper/diaper-edit/sleep/sleep-edit) and opened via .SheetOpen, so HTMX swaps reuse one bottom-sheet container rather than shipping a dialog per partial.

nodes.label: Inline Theme Bootstrap Script
nodes.rationale: Runs synchronously in <head> before CSS paints, reading localStorage key nurtur.theme and hour-of-day (night = 21:00-07:00) so day/night theme is decided client-side without a flash of the wrong theme; the catch fallback still picks a night/day theme if storage or matchMedia throws.

nodes.label: Server-Side View Dispatch
nodes.rationale: The layout is one shell that switches main content by .View (timeline / settings / default dashboard) instead of separate page layouts, keeping header, sync chip, dock and dialogs identical across screens; the dock is suppressed on settings.

nodes.label: Auth Mode Variants (chooser / signup / signin)
nodes.rationale: One template branches on .AuthMode so a fresh server walks the operator through chooser -> secret-key signup, while a provisioned server only shows signin; signup is gated by .SignupOpen because the server holds exactly one account, and login supports either an account (username/password) or a plain passcode.

nodes.label: Offline Resilience Stance
nodes.rationale: Copy states logs are already safe on the server and will sync when the network returns, so the offline screen is reassurance rather than an error; mirrors the layout offline banner that says new logs wait for the connection.

nodes.label: One-Tap Optional-Detail Logging
nodes.rationale: A diaper is logged by a single POST with only type=wet|dirty|both; colour, consistency and notes live in a separate edit sheet, so a tired parent at 3am never faces a required form.

nodes.label: Day/Night Sleep Split
nodes.rationale: Total sleep is reported as Day plus Night totals (settings-defined night window) because night sleep is the number parents actually care about; the sheet also allows back-filling an earlier sleep with start/end/notes.

nodes.label: Feed Lifecycle HTMX Endpoints
nodes.rationale: POST /feeds starts a side, POST /feeds/{id}/switch flips side and POST /feeds/{id}/stop closes the feed; all three return the timer card plus out-of-band status/last-nursed/sleep/timeline fragments so one tap refreshes every derived view.

nodes.label: Data Export Endpoints
nodes.rationale: JSON, CSV and SQL dumps are offered before upgrades or migrations; the SQL file is intended to replay into a fresh Turso database (README restore drill), making the single-file DB the real backup boundary.

nodes.label: Sync Telemetry Card
nodes.rationale: Exposes mode, status, last push/pull and pending counts; the copy states logging always writes to the local database first so a cloud outage never blocks a feed or a diaper - local-first is the core architectural promise.

nodes.label: Feed Edit Sheet
nodes.rationale: Active feeds only allow editing the segment start (plus -5/+5 minute nudge buttons) because the timer owns the end; finished feeds expose start, end and left/right minute totals, with the note that segments are rebuilt left then right.

nodes.label: Status Card
nodes.rationale: Generic card for nursing/diaper/sleep driven entirely by data (Kind, Tone, Icon, Href, Value, Detail, Secondary); tapping it hx-gets .Href into #action-dialog, so the same markup opens whichever sheet the server decides.

nodes.label: Sync Chip
nodes.rationale: Polls /partials/sync every 90 seconds and links to /settings, giving ambient sync health without a websocket; the whole element replaces itself via outerHTML.

nodes.label: Nursing Timer Card
nodes.rationale: Carries data-feed-id, data-side, data-started-at and data-server-now on the root so static/js/timer.js can tick locally from the server clock without polling; start/switch/stop all hx-target #timer-card so the card is always replaced as one unit and cached/offline hints stay inside it.

nodes.label: Toast Notification
nodes.rationale: Supports an optional action rendered as either an HTMX POST form (e.g. undo) or a GET link, letting destructive or reversible actions be offered inside the confirmation itself.

nodes.label: Timeline Days with Load More
nodes.rationale: Cursor pagination via ?before=NextCursor, with a plain href fallback plus hx-get on /timeline/partial so loading earlier days works even without JavaScript.

nodes.label: Timeline Delete Placeholder
nodes.rationale: After a delete the row is replaced by a hidden li keyed by DeletedKey so the DOM keeps a stable anchor for later inserts/undo without leaving a visible gap.

nodes.label: Maskable App Icon
nodes.rationale: Same cream Pip face artwork as icon.svg but translated to 128,128 and scaled to 4 instead of 96/5, shrinking the glyph into the maskable safe zone so Android launchers can crop to circle/squircle without clipping ears.
